usage: RealignReads.py [-h] --bam_fn BAM_FN --ref_fn REF_FN
                       [--read_fn READ_FN] [--ctgName CTGNAME]
                       [--ctgStart CTGSTART] [--ctgEnd CTGEND]
                       [--full_aln_regions FULL_ALN_REGIONS]
                       [--samtools SAMTOOLS] [--minCoverage MINCOVERAGE]
                       [--minMQ MINMQ] [--extend_bed EXTEND_BED]

Reads realignment

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --bam_fn BAM_FN       Sorted BAM file input, required
  --ref_fn REF_FN       Reference fasta file input, required
  --read_fn READ_FN     Output realigned BAM. Default directly pass reads to
                        CreateTensor_phasing using PIPE. Default: PIPE
  --ctgName CTGNAME     The name of sequence to be processed
  --ctgStart CTGSTART   The 1-based starting position of the sequence to be
                        processed
  --ctgEnd CTGEND       The 1-based inclusive ending position of the sequence
                        to be processed
  --full_aln_regions FULL_ALN_REGIONS
                        Realign reads only in the provided bed regions
  --samtools SAMTOOLS   Path to the 'samtools', samtools version >= 1.10 is
                        required, default: samtools
  --minCoverage MINCOVERAGE
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Minimum coverage required to call a
                        variant, default: 2.000000
  --minMQ MINMQ         EXPERIMENTAL: Minimum Mapping Quality. Mapping quality
                        lower than the setting will be filtered, default: 5
  --extend_bed EXTEND_BED
                        DEBUG: Extend the regions in the --bed_fn by a few bp
                        for tensor creation, default extend 16bp
